title: Scientific feedback reveals productive regimes beyond training conventions
abstract: arXiv:2512.15756v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Human-imposed design conventions can restrict the alternatives represented in scientific training data and shape the search preferences learned by generative models. We show that scientific performance feedback can redirect the learned search distribution toward productive regions beyond those conventions, without explicitly rewarding departures from them. We test this process in reactor lattice design with simulated feedback and chemical reaction-condition selection with measured yields, using a pretrained sequence policy and a small non-language policy, respectively. In both settings, adaptation improves scientific performance while increasing generation of choices excluded from the corresponding supervised data. In measured reactions, probability on task-specific ligand choices excluded from training rises from 0.29 to 0.70-0.71 as expected yield error decreases. translated_title: 科学反馈揭示了超越训练惯例的高产区域
translated_abstract: 人为设定的设计惯例可能会限制科学训练数据中所呈现的备选方案，并塑造生成模型学习到的搜索偏好。我们证明，科学性能反馈可以将学习到的搜索分布重新引导至这些惯例之外的高产区域，而无需明确奖励对这些惯例的偏离。我们在两个场景中测试了这一过程：使用模拟反馈的反应堆栅格设计，以及使用实测产率的化学反应条件选择，分别采用预训练的序列策略和一个小型非语言策略。在这两种设置中，自适应过程在提升科学性能的同时，增加了被相应监督数据所排除的选择的生成。在实测反应中，随着预期产率误差的降低，被排除在训练之外的任务特定配体选择的概率从0.29上升到0.70-0.71。栅格设置中的对照实验表明，高产区域……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 科学性能反馈能够引导生成模型自主探索超越人类设计惯例的高产区域，在提升科学性能的同时生成训练数据中被排除的选择，且无需显式奖励对惯例的偏离。
en_tdlr: Scientific performance feedback can redirect generative models toward productive regions beyond human-imposed design conventions, improving scientific performance while generating choices excluded from training data, without explicitly rewarding departures from those conventions.
